_README: The COMPONENT MODEL for salonphoto — authored by Claude from deterministic evidence, amended and approved by the operator at step_model_author. apply_component_model.py consumes `types` + `childTypes`; every other key is the reviewable canon (zoning map, entities, islands, chrome, templates, scope report). nodeType identifiers FREEZE at first deploy: the model governs display names, fields and views, never renames a deployed type.

entityCounts._total: ~187 details; sources: /sitemap.xml (144 fr URLs) UNION the link census (card-reached details the sitemap omits)

templates.name: home
templates.tell: the ONLY page with 0 breadcrumbs and the only .component.carousel (measured across all 27 pages)

areas.name: main
areas.note: OPEN composition surface led by sdp:cols

templates.name: standard
templates.tell: breadcrumb (26/26) + a .component.title page-title banner (25/26) + one main column; 22 of them fall in one arrangement cluster

templates.name: MainResource
templates.pages: none in the menu — renders sdp:newsArticle / sdp:event full-page
templates.tell: entity detail URLs (article / agenda / programme). Not a crawled page role: the template exists to render a mainResource node at its own URL

_templateNote: 3 templates, matching the 3 universal roles. The 3 singleton arrangement clusters (salon_a-propos, salon_partenaires, agenda-photo+photo-pass) differ by CONTENT MIX, not skeleton — they stay on `standard`. A 4th template would buy nothing and cost a governance contract.

sdp:siteHeader.name: Site Header
sdp:siteHeader._content: top-bar: 5 social links + '#SalonPhotoetVideo' + 2 CTAs (Devenir exposant / Votre espace exposant) + search. header-navigation: logo, date ('8-11 OCTOBRE 2026'), lieu ('Grande Halle de la Villette'), the 'Acheter mon billet' CTA.

sdp:mainNavigation.name: Main Navigation
sdp:mainNavigation._scope: ABSOLUTE — tree-driven, 6 L1 items x up to 7 children (Level1 x135 / Level2 x459 keys)
sdp:mainNavigation._note: NEVER frozen markup: the page tree IS the menu (rule 13). 2 levels is what the source has; the view supports 3.

sdp:footer.name: Footer
sdp:footer._scope: ABSOLUTE (27/27) — newsletter form (texte-newsletter/texte-email/email/validation-valid), socials (texte-reseaux-sociaux), link columns (lien x243, sib=6), logo

sdp:banner.name: Page Title Banner
sdp:banner._scope: TEMPLATE-level on 25/26 inner pages (title x25) + banner2 x1
sdp:banner._fields: titre + arriere-titre (the ghosted background word) + image-de-fond background

sdp:richTextSection.name: Rich Text Section
sdp:richTextSection._scope: the workhorse: content x122 + rich-text x29 declared instances; census signature 'plain' x151 of 207 bands
sdp:richTextSection._contactBlockNote: contact-block (1 instance, home) is the newsletter/contact band: prose + a form. Decided as richTextSection; its form is an island decision, already recorded under islands.

sdp:mediaText.name: Media & Text
sdp:mediaText._scope: content-block x4 + content-block-vertical-image x1; the image+prose split band

sdp:cardGrid.name: Card Grid
sdp:cardGrid._scope: RECORD tier: picture-grid x4 (repeat), carousel x1 (4 Slides), partners-carrousel x1, partners-2-list x5, quicklinks x1
sdp:cardGrid._note: ONE container type, four views — this is where SXA's five different repeating-tile components collapse. The layout property (grid|carousel|slider) drives the rest.

sdp:accordion.name: Accordion
sdp:accordion._scope: accordion x8 (all on infos-pratiques_faq, the 33-band page) + tabs x2

sdp:jcrQuery.name: Content List
sdp:jcrQuery._scope: search-results x10 + page-list x8: the LISTING components. Replaces every SXA facet/search construct.
sdp:jcrQuery._note: CRITICAL: SXA facets hit /sxa/search, which has no Jahia backend — 10 facetFilter island instances measured. They become a real sdp:jcrQuery over a mainResource folder, with the badge values as Jahia CATEGORIES filtered client-side (proven on supercar-garage). A ported facet renders empty controls that list nothing.

sdp:layoutSection.name: Layout Section
sdp:layoutSection._scope: layout plumbing that holds real children (container x2, snippet x18)

sdp:cols.name: Columns
sdp:cols._note: The layout primitive every OPEN area is led by (migration rule 16: every module ships a GridRow). SXA expresses columns as Bootstrap classes on the component wrapper, so there is no source type to map — it is required regardless.

sdp:statCallout.name: Stat Callout
sdp:statCallout._scope: date-lieu-horaires x1 (3 title/description pairs = 3 stats). key-figures was declared in the 2026-06 corpus and is expected back once detail pages are crawled.

sdp:subNavigation.name: Section Sub-Navigation
sdp:subNavigation._note: Tree-driven sibling menu. Candidate wherever page-list renders the parent section's children rather than content cards — to be confirmed per instance at load time.

sdp:newsArticle.name: Actualité
sdp:newsArticle._scope: 6 card-reached dated details under actualite-photo/actus (9 uncrawled links)

_measuredFieldSurface.title: field-titre on the `title` component (also the <title> tag)
_measuredFieldSurface.date: field-date-de-publication on the same `title` component — e.g. '27/07/2026'
_measuredFieldSurface.summary: the intro band's field-content — identical to the page's meta description
_measuredFieldSurface.image: /-/media/Project/.../salon/actu/<slug>/... with real alt text -> DAM weakref, alt becomes the DAM node's jcr:title
_measuredFieldSurface.categories: the listing badge vocabulary (Actualités / Professionnels / Amateurs) -> jmix:categorized, never CND fields
_measuredFieldSurface.body: NOT one richtext: a SEQUENCE of bands — content (standfirst, section headings, prose), rich-text, content-block-vertical-image (image+text), video-content-block ('En vidéo'), image

sdp:newsArticle._modelAsk: Make the article a CONTAINER: keep title/date/summary/hero/categories as properties, compose the body from CHILD content nodes (sdp:richTextSection / sdp:mediaText / video) rendered with RenderChildren. The shipped `article` archetype currently declares a single `body` richtext, so this needs a producer change in archetypes.py — a Phase-4 build item, not a hand patch.
sdp:newsArticle._why: Flattening the body into one richtext would make every in-article image block and the video section non-contributable, and would violate the rule that every visitor-readable string is an editable field.

sdp:event.name: Événement
sdp:event._scope: 72 card-reached dated details: programme/Evenement 37, agenda-photo 20, expositions-photos 9, animations 6
sdp:event._note: ONE type, four folders. Agenda entries and salon programme events share a field surface (title/date/location/body/image); separating them into two types would duplicate a shape (dup-shapes.sh would fail it).

sdp:cardItem._why: Every measured card carries a category badge above the title ('Actualités', 'Agenda', 'Expositions', 'Professionnels'). On mainResource cards that badge is a Jahia category, but on hand-authored grid tiles (picture-grid: picturegriditemsoustitre) it is contributed text — so the atom needs one editable eyebrow slot. Rule 24: every visitor-readable string is a contributor field.

contract.source: data-properties JSON on the component root; behaviour lives in the SXA XA-API bundle we exclude

islands.note: The shipped SourceCarousel island targets Embla `[data-slot="carousel"]` (SingPost) and will NOT attach to this markup. Fade transition + 4s autoplay + pause-on-hover must be honoured or the hero shows one frozen slide.

contract.css: cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/swiffy-slider@1.6.0 — vendor it into static/ (recorded in scope-rules keptEmbeds)

islands.note: Scroll-snap paging + indicator buttons. A second, structurally different carousel: two islands, not one.

islands.decision: ADOPT — one Collapsible island on sdp:accordion
islands.note: FAQ is the 33-band page: 8 accordions. Must render flat/expanded in Page Builder edit mode (renderContext.isEditMode).

islands.decision: REPLACE — not an island: a sdp:jcrQuery + Jahia categories + client-side chip filter
islands.note: There is no /sxa/search backend in Jahia. Porting the widget ships empty dropdowns that list nothing (measured on supercar-garage). The badge vocabularies (Actualités/Professionnels/Amateurs, Agenda/Expositions) become a category tree.

islands.decision: ADOPT minimal — a client island that posts to a Jahia endpoint, or Jahia Forms
islands.note: One instance per page via the footer AbsoluteArea, not 27 components. Sitecore ExperienceForms scripts are excluded.
No island needed. Never emit <video><source type="video/youtube"> — it never plays (harness-known).
item-content-popin-picture was declared in the 2026-06 corpus; likely a speaker/exhibitor detail popin. Decide once detail pages are crawled.

chrome.breadcrumb: template-level, rendered from the page tree (26/26 pages) — sxaIgnored, never a content component
chrome.note: AbsoluteArea singletons must be POPULATED to render in the Page Builder edit canvas (harness-known); jmix:hiddenType stays on them.

sxaIgnored.reason: 43 instances: 27 zero-height spacers (scope-excluded), 10 empty, 1 script. The 5 that carry a real iframe are modelled as embeds on their host band.
a background-image wrapper — becomes an image property on the hosting band, not a type
layout wrapper; maps to sdp:layoutSection when it holds children
prev/next on entity details — a MainResource template concern, not a placeable component
a bare anchor (41 instances): a field on its host band, never a component
an SXA field wrapper (798 instances), not a component — the L2 tier's field noise
JSON-LD only, scope-excluded; SEO lives on sdpmix:seo
Bootstrap layout wrapper; sdp:cols / sdp:layoutSection cover it
paging UI of the absent SXA search backend; sdp:jcrQuery handles paging

excluded.why: OneTrust banner + preference centre + its cdn.cookielaw.org loader, 27/27 pages. Was supplying 20+ of 35 ABSOLUTE zone keys before exclusion.
Cloudflare RUM beacon, chatbase chatbot, GTM (noscript iframe + inline bootstrap). Caused /cdn-cgi/rum and /api/get-chatbot-styles 404s in the reviewed mirror.

openQuestions: Exhibitor catalogue (/infos-pratiques/catalogue + /exposants): entity folder, editorial page with an outbound link, or out of scope? Its list is not in the captured DOM (facet-driven).
expositions-photos (9) and animations (6): entity details or sub-pages? The rule breaks ties to PAGE; confirm by crawling 2 samples.

Ticketing (/fr-FR/billet) was skipped as a utility URL by design — confirm that is wanted, since 'Acheter mon billet' is the site's primary CTA (the lien-billetterie page with its 2 Weezevent widgets IS captured).
Detail-page crawl is required before load_main_resources: ~87 entity URLs. It also completes the declared inventory (36 types now vs 42 in the 2026-06 corpus; the 6 extras live on detail pages).

cssSlots.strategy: Hybrid: every emitted view wears the source's captured classes (classMap slots) over the semantic fallback skin, and per-component CSS is captured into each SDC folder after load (step_component_css).
cssSlots.theme: Comexposium Master1-Photo Model-Site theme + Bootstrap 4 + FontAwesome Pro. 147/156 assets localized; 9 residual font/image files and the swiffy-slider CSS must be vendored in step_assets.
